description: Read OpenVibe.Chat's resource index (ADR-048, plan T13 step 8 phase 2, a person-owned resource): GET /api/v1/resources lists Chat's rooms as a page of common.resource-summary@1 (common.resource-list-result@1). Kind chat.room, id the room's slug, named by its name, state its visibility, owner its owner_subject when it has one. Rooms belong to people, not projects, so a room carries no project_id and no OVRN; GET /api/v1/resources/:ovrn answers 404 for every name.
